name: coincident-torus-union
why: A torus unioned with itself turned about its axis. The fuse is right (two faces, 789.57 mm³ exact), but UnifySameDomain merges them into a face of the whole toroidal surface with no wire at all — valid to BRepCheck, invisible to BRepMesh, which left it untriangulated and the reply read 'a mesh with no vertices'. A wireless face is now rebuilt with the surface's natural bounds. If it comes back the worker refuses by counting untriangulated faces and names the 0.01 mm overlap.
